title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410 million compute deal with Amazon
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Recursive’s $400 million outlay represents the bulk of the company’s fundraising to date.
body: Startup Recursive Superintelligence has finalized a $410 million cloud compute agreement with Amazon Web Services. The company will utilize AWS's specialized high-performance computing clusters to scale its training pipelines for self-improving AI architectures. The deal underscores the accelerating demand for enterprise cloud capacity tailored for large-scale training. AWS will supply custom accelerators, ensuring the startup has the computing resources needed to benchmark and deploy its autonomous agent models over the next several years. This marks a major milestone in cloud computing partnerships.
